messages.text: PR#13 has comments from an expert human reviewer, address them and push an update to the PR
I’ll read the review comments on PR #13, address them on its branch, run the relevant checks, and push an update.

The reviewer asks to retain A and C1, reduce disk overlap, and study layer spacing against hit coverage and track-parameter resolution—especially near η≈1.1. I’ll run a bounded optimisation study, preserve the earlier results for traceability, and flag recommendations that still depend on engineering inputs.

The first check shows that the transverse lever arm shrinks through η≈1.1–1.2 even while the hit count remains fairly stable. I’m scanning the outer barrel and first endcap disks, alongside the first two pixel radii. For C1, I’m testing row spacing uniform in η; that gives wider z spacing at larger η.

The scans expose a real tradeoff: separating the disk volumes removes overlap but also loses hits in some transition regions. Some settings improve average resolution while worsening local points, so I’ve added an explicit penalty for those losses and am checking nearby disk z positions. The update will show the adverse cases as well as the gains.

A finer-grid check caught a local momentum-resolution loss that the first coarse scan missed. I’ve retained that finding, refined the η grid, and added a joint scan of outer radius and barrel/endcap positions. The zero-material limit and a beam-pipe scattering test with an analytic answer both pass.

The A and C1 revisions improve the estimated momentum resolution near η = 1.1 by about 6–9%. They still lose hits and worsen resolution in some other regions, so the review response presents them as study iterations. Both two-page briefs are ready; I’m checking the evidence and updating the review record before pushing.

All 27 tracker tests pass, including the scattering and covariance checks. I also found and repaired a malformed JSON boundary already present in the PR’s tracking file. The remaining scientific work is explicit: repair transition hit losses, refine C1 row placement, and obtain realistic beam-pipe and service envelopes.

The required local tests and dashboard build pass, and I’ve inspected all four pages of the new briefs. I’m publishing the response with both the η = 1.1 improvement and the worst local regressions visible, then requesting another expert review. No design approval or sign-off is being recorded.

The update is pushed to PR #13. I’ve revised its executive summary, posted the response to the expert comments, and requested re-review from `noemina`. I’m finishing the exact-revision review record and checking CI.

Updated and pushed [PR #13](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/13) at `f57e26e`.

- Retained A/C1; added revised two-page briefs and responses to all expert points.
- Added optimisation studies, validation evidence and source references.
- Documented remaining hit losses, resolution regressions and missing engineering inputs.
- Requested re-review from `noemina`.

Local tests, session validation and hosted CI pass. No design sign-off recorded.
